messages:
sam: dropping the launch blog draft + webinar stub in Drive. need hero CTA, two short CTAs in body, and a final pass on benchmark phrasing. link: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch_v2

olivia: looking now. hero headline draft: 'Make inference predictable for production apps.' feels long  maybe 'Predictable inference for production' ?

marta: prefer 'Predictable inference for production' but add a 6-word subhead that mentions latency/cost. e.g., 'Low-latency, cost-aware LLM serving'.

devon: for funnel: hero CTA = Register now (immediate capture). inline CTA under benchmarks = Get the deck (email + nurture). suggestion for hero button text: 'Reserve your spot'. Also we need HubSpot form id and hidden fields to wire.

dana: i'll wire once you confirm form id + hidden fields. also recommend including a secondary 'Contact sales' link for enterprise.

legal-bot: flag: avoid 'best-in-class' and absolute claims. use qualifiers like 'production-grade' or cite the eval repo. for benchmarks include measurement context (model, seq length, p95, cost formula). paste eval URL here for signoff.

sam: updated doc: changed hero to Marta's suggestion + subhead. added benchmark callout with method note: '(internal eval on a 1B-token workload; p95 latency; cost = $ per 1k tokens)'. still need the exact citation link.

marta: small edit request  can we make the benchmark stat a one-line callout: '0.9s p95 latency, $0.10 per 1k tokens (internal eval).' legal will want the repo link in the footnote.

devon: HubSpot details: form id FH-67890. hidden fields: {"utm_source":"blog","utm_medium":"organic","utm_campaign":"redwood_prod_launch"}. sample hero url: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=redwood_prod_launch&utm_content=hero_cta

dana: wiring now. preview page: https://go.redwood.ai/preview/FH-67890 (will remove preview after QA). adding hidden fields and mapping utm_campaign to campaign_id=RL-2026.

legal-bot: please paste the eval link in-thread when available. tentative legal hold removed for now pending citation. please avoid comparative language without citation.

olivia: dropped eval link in the doc footer: https://repo.redwood.ai/evals/launch_benchmarks. also trimmed the second paragraph to a single sentence per Jeff's earlier feedback.

sam: quick publish checklist:
```
- hero copy locked
- subhead locked
- benchmark callout + citation present
- HubSpot FH-67890 wired and previewed
- webinar page live
- sales notification scheduled
```
react with :thumbsup: if good to publish Wed morning.

dana: :thumbsup: preview live and form mapping complete. will hand off final test creds in DM.

marta: :thumbsup: will QA deck footers for the citation link.

olivia: thanks team  i'll queue the CMS publish and send the webinar invite to the list. target publish Wed 9am PT.

legal-bot: legal signoff: OK to publish with current phraseology and linked eval repo.

sam: publishing Tue -> Wed timeline confirmed. thanks all."
